bundle.shortDescription: A digital dead-man's switch and encrypted legacy vault.
bundle.longDescription: ZDeadDrop encrypts something, defines who receives it and under what condition, and lets that condition be checked without trusting a server with the plaintext. If you go silent, the right things reach the right people — and nobody else, ever.
